davlat-dasturi.seoDescription: We reviewed Davlat Dasturi for 2026: minimum deposit, claims, red flags and the scorecard. Read before you register.
davlat-dasturi.deck: Davlat Dasturi sells a browser-based trading desk. We read every page it publishes and checked the claims one at a time.
davlat-dasturi.depositMethods: Bank cards, bank transfer, PayPal, Skrill
intro: Davlat Dasturi arrives with the familiar pitch: AI analysis, automatic entries, a US$250 start and a practice account. The pitch is polished. The fine print is where the questions begin, and that is what this review measures.

In practice it works like this: you register free, fund US$250, choose automatic or manual mode, and let the models propose entries across 9 assets while the practice account lets you learn without risk.
This review is built from the platform own words - every claim, fee note and disclosure it publishes. Where the page disagrees with itself, we flag it. The score follows the evidence.
whatItClaims: A sparse three-step onboarding aimed at first-time users.
One toggle separating automatic execution from manual approval.
Markets span crypto, bonds, shares and commodities, with derivatives also listed.
A simulated-funds demo open before any deposit.
A $250 minimum, free registration and payouts advertised within 24 hours.
whatWeChecked: The fee wording: no charges claimed, spreads left unexplained.
The performance quotes: landing-page figures with no source attached.
The broker partners: mentioned in passing, never named.
Who runs the platform, and under what licence, is unclear.
The mode switch: whether manual approval is truly one toggle.
The asset menu: bonds and commodities promised beside crypto.

faqs.q: Is Davlat Dasturi safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

bottomLine: Davlat Dasturi reads as a functioning AI trading service with the standard package, and the product itself clears the bar for a cautious trial.
The final score lands at 4.5 - a capable platform held back by its own paperwork. Start small, verify the claims yourself and never trade money you cannot lose.
